previous_versions.body:
We have content from:
* OAuth-related RFCs
* and OIDC specification https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html

The problem is that the style is different in those, for example, in RFC, it is used in text "access token" but in OIDC spec it is always camel-case "Access Token".

In short, we can not be aligned with both, I prefer to use the RFC style (lowercase).
